summary: Confirmed on the operator's site and ResNexus page: Good Sam Park (10% off), 50-amp full hookups, pull-throughs to 102 ft, showers/laundry/store/WiFi, reservable online. Added fees $76-79.20 (full-hookup sites, Oct-Nov 2026 weeknights; cheaper site types and 2027 dates were not priced). Not stated: season (no January 2027 site was priced, but nothing says the park closes), site count, military discount (left derived).
